newsitem.title: USA: Ultra Pac sees profits on Q4, 1996.
newsitem.headline: Ultra Pac sees profits on Q4, 1996.

text.p: Ultra Pac Inc said it expects to post moderate earnings in the fourth quarter ending January 31 and to be profitable for the full year.
Profitability is "primarily due to improved gross margins resulting from lower raw material and production labor costs as well as improved manufacturing efficiencies," it said.

Last year, the food packaging company incurred a net loss of $2 million in the fourth quarter and a loss of $3.1 million for the full year. The company said it has not been profitable in the fourth quarter since January 1992.
